model.src:
(block System
  :type "Module"
  (sketch "A randomly generated system for testing layout rules.")
  (shape Request (sketch "A request."))
  (shape Event (sketch "A event."))
  (shape Snapshot (sketch "A snapshot."))
  (shape Command (sketch "A command."))
  (shape Receipt (sketch "A receipt."))
  (behavior Durable (port :in Event :as keep) (sketch "Retains events until acknowledged."))
  (behavior Observable (port :out Snapshot :as metric) (sketch "Reports its own health."))
  (level
    (block ShadowRouter
      (implements Observable)
      (sketch "Turns raw input into typed commands and rejects anything malformed before it reaches storage."))
    (block RetryParser
      (gives Snapshot :as done)
      (implements Durable)
      (sketch "Keeps the latest state per key.")
      (level
        (block RemoteIndex
          (gives Receipt :as emit)
          (sketch "Thin wrapper."))
        (block RetryMetrics
          (gives Command :as emit)
          (implements Durable)
          (sketch "Turns raw input into typed commands and rejects anything malformed before it reaches storage."))
        (block RemoteCache
          (takes Request :as evt)
          (gives Event)
          (implements Observable)
          (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind.")
          (level
            (block Cache
              (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at."))
            (block ShadowSearch
              (takes Command :as evt)
              (sketch "Thin wrapper."))
            (adjacent
              (block BatchCatalog
                (gives Receipt :as done)
                (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind."))
              (block LiveSession
                (takes Event :as evt)
                (gives Command :as emit)
                (implements Durable)
                (sketch "Turns raw input into typed commands and rejects anything malformed before it reaches storage."))
              (block Editor
                (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind."))))
          (level
            (block ShadowQueue
              (gives Receipt :as done)
              (implements Durable)
              (sketch "Thin wrapper.")))))))
  (level
    (block LocalBilling
      (takes Receipt :as evt)
      (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at.")
      (level
        (adjacent
          (block BatchUploader :type "Process"
            (implements Durable)
            (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen.")
            (level
              (adjacent
                (block Metrics
                  (sketch "Keeps the latest state per key."))
                (block ShadowLedger
                  (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at."))
                (block RemoteRenderer
                  (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at."))
                (block RemoteMailer :type "Feature"
                  (takes Request)
                  (sketch "Thin wrapper.")))))
          (block RetryAuth
            (takes Request :as req)
            (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind.")
            (level
              (block RemoteQueue
                (takes Receipt :as req)
                (gives Command)
                (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind."))))
          (block ShadowMailer
            (gives Request :as emit)
            (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind.")
            (level
              (adjacent
                (block EdgeEditor :type "Service"
                  (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at."))
                (block RemoteSearch :type "Store"
                  (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at."))
                (block LiveQueue
                  (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen.")))))
          (block RemoteFeed
            (takes Event :as req)
            (sketch "Turns raw input into typed commands and rejects anything malformed before it reaches storage.")))
        (adjacent
          (block Mailer
            (takes Event :as evt)
            (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind."))
          (block EdgeSync :type "Feature"
            (takes Request :as evt)
            (gives Receipt :as done)
            (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen."))
          (block BatchPlanner
            (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind."))
          (block ShadowPricing :type "Store"
            (gives Event :as done)
            (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen.")))
        (block RemoteParser :type "Feature"
          (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind.")))
      (level
        (block RetryMailer
          (gives Event)
          (sketch "Keeps the latest state per key.")
          (level
            (block LiveFeed
              (gives Event :as emit)
              (sketch "Turns raw input into typed commands and rejects anything malformed before it reaches storage."))
            (block BatchInbox
              (implements Durable)
              (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at."))
            (block EdgeAudit
              (gives Command)
              (sketch "Turns raw input into typed commands and rejects anything malformed before it reaches storage.")))
          (level
            (block RemoteAudit
              (takes Event :as req)
              (implements Durable)
              (sketch "Thin wrapper."))))))))
